Dates and moments use ISO formatting. Invalid typed values raise `TypeError` or `ValueError`. No returned mutable object may alias constructor input.

import datetime
import decimal
import hashlib
import hmac
import unittest

from solution import SealedText, SealedNumber, SealedDay, SealedMoment


def decrypt_payload(token, secret):
    version, type_tag, level, cipher_hex, mac_hex = token.split("|")
    prefix = "|".join((version, type_tag, level, cipher_hex))
    expected = hmac.new(secret, prefix.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(mac_hex, expected):
        raise AssertionError("invalid constructor MAC")
    encrypted = bytes.fromhex(cipher_hex)
    clear = bytes(value ^ secret[index % len(secret)] for index, value in enumerate(encrypted))
    return version, type_tag, int(level), clear.decode()


class SealedValueTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_concrete_types_round_trip_and_serialize_as_specified(self):
        secret = b"key"
        cases = [
            (SealedText, "hello \u2603", "hello \u2603"),
            (SealedNumber, decimal.Decimal("12.340"), "12.340"),
            (SealedDay, datetime.date(2024, 2, 29), "2024-02-29"),
            (SealedMoment, datetime.datetime(2024, 2, 29, 12, 3, 4, 5000), "2024-02-29T12:03:04.005000"),
        ]
        tags = set()
        for cls, value, serialized in cases:
            with self.subTest(cls=cls.__name__):
                sealed = cls(value, secret, 2)
                self.assertIsInstance(sealed.token, str)
                version, tag, level, clear = decrypt_payload(sealed.token, secret)
                self.assertEqual(version, "SV1")
                self.assertEqual(level, 2)
                self.assertEqual(clear, serialized)
                tags.add(tag)
                self.assertEqual(sealed.reveal(2), value)
                self.assertEqual(sealed.reveal(99), value)
                restored = cls.from_token(sealed.token, secret)
                self.assertEqual(restored.token, sealed.token)
                self.assertEqual(restored.reveal(2), value)
        self.assertEqual(len(tags), 4)

    def test_number_returns_decimal(self):
        for value in ("1.25", 7, 0.5):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                result = SealedNumber(value, b"s", 0).reveal(0)
                self.assertIsInstance(result, decimal.Decimal)
                self.assertEqual(result, decimal.Decimal(value))

    def test_clearance_and_read_only_token(self):
        sealed = SealedText("classified", b"secret", 3)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            sealed.reveal(2)
        for clearance in (True, 3.0, "3", None):
            with self.subTest(clearance=clearance):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    sealed.reveal(clearance)
        with self.assertRaises((AttributeError, TypeError)):
            sealed.token = "replacement"

    def test_constructor_validation(self):
        for secret in (b"", "secret", bytearray(b"x"), None):
            with self.subTest(secret=secret):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    SealedText("x", secret, 0)
        for level in (True, -1, 1.0, "1"):
            with self.subTest(level=level):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    SealedText("x", b"s", level)
        bad_values = [
            (SealedText, 1),
            (SealedDay, datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1)),
            (SealedDay, "2024-01-01"),
            (SealedMoment, datetime.date(2024, 1, 1)),
            (SealedMoment, "2024-01-01T00:00:00"),
            (SealedNumber, object()),
            (SealedNumber, "not-a-number"),
        ]
        for cls, value in bad_values:
            with self.subTest(cls=cls.__name__, value=value):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError, decimal.InvalidOperation)):
                    cls(value, b"s", 0)

    def test_from_token_rejects_wrong_type_or_secret_and_malformed_tokens(self):
        secret = b"right"
        text = SealedText("abc", secret, 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            SealedNumber.from_token(text.token, secret)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            SealedText.from_token(text.token, b"wrong")
        parts = text.token.split("|")
        malformed = [
            None,
            "",
            "SV1|too|few",
            "SV2|" + "|".join(parts[1:]),
            "|".join(parts[:2] + ["-1"] + parts[3:]),
            "|".join(parts[:3] + ["zz"] + parts[4:]),
            "|".join(parts[:-1] + ["0" * 64]),
            text.token + "|extra",
        ]
        for token in malformed:
            with self.subTest(token=token):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    SealedText.from_token(token, secret)

    def test_validly_authenticated_but_invalid_payload_is_rejected(self):
        good = SealedDay(datetime.date(2024, 1, 1), b"k", 0).token
        version, tag, level, cipher_hex, _ = good.split("|")
        bad_clear = b"not-a-date"
        bad_cipher = bytes(byte ^ b"k"[0] for byte in bad_clear).hex()
        prefix = "|".join((version, tag, level, bad_cipher))
        mac = hmac.new(b"k", prefix.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            SealedDay.from_token(prefix + "|" + mac, b"k")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
